annotations.title: Put an email in the trash

description: Moves one inbox email to its mailbox's trash when BumbleBox certifies it as noise (spam, newsletter, promotion, with a unanimous safety vote and no known contact or action word). Any other email is not moved: it becomes a proposal the user confirms in one tap in BumbleBox. Never a permanent deletion; undone by restore_to_inbox.

email_id.description: Email id, as returned by search_emails or list_to_answer.

reason.description: Why, shown to the user with a proposal.
